# Stay Willas — Luxury Private Pool Villas in Maharashtra

> Stay Willas (https://www.staywillas.com) is a premier luxury holiday rental brand in Maharashtra, India. Specializing in handpicked, fully managed, verified private pool villas in Lonavala, Khopoli, Karjat, Alibaug, and Igatpuri. Designed for family weekend staycations, corporate offsites, celebration trips, and pet-friendly retreats near Mumbai and Pune.

For complete machine-readable specifications, property specs, pricing structures, and prompt Q&A data for LLMs, see:
- **Full Knowledge Base**: https://www.staywillas.com/llms-full.txt

## Featured Properties

### 1. The Angle House (Lonavala)
- **Type**: 4 BHK Modern Architectural Luxury Private Pool Villa
- **Location**: Lonavala, Maharashtra (Near Pawna Lake & Lohagad Fort)
- **Capacity**: 12 to 16 Guests
- **Highlights**: Private pool, double-height glass living room, fenced pet-friendly lawn, in-house private chef, 24/7 caretaker.
- **URL**: https://www.staywillas.com/villa/the-angle-house

### 2. Canopy Crest (Khopoli)
- **Type**: 3 BHK Mountain Sanctuary Private Pool Villa
- **Location**: Khopoli, Maharashtra (Near Imagica & Zenith Waterfall)
- **Capacity**: 10 to 15 Guests
- **Highlights**: Private pool overlooking Sahyadri peaks, gazebo lounge, in-house private chef, sprawling lawn, corporate offsite infrastructure.
- **URL**: https://www.staywillas.com/villa/canopy-crest
